name: posttooluse-lsp-hint
description: Hint LSP availability after writing/editing JS/TS files
reason:
LSP available for this file. Use LSP tool to get precise code intelligence:
- documentSymbol: list all functions/classes/variables
- goToDefinition: jump to where a symbol is defined
- findReferences: find all usages of a symbol
- hover: get type signature and docs
- incomingCalls/outgoingCalls: trace call graph
